en: A black-and-white image showing a classical building partly obscured by trees and shrubbery. The building features prominent columns and a pediment, with the word 'KURTHEATER' visible on its facade. The foreground includes landscaped gardens and a stairway leading up to the building. At the bottom of the postcard, the printed text reads 'Bad Elster' on the left and 'Kurtheater' on the right.
